svg.title: What I've shipped and what's cooking
svg.desc: Shipped: Celestial Observatory V15, Sky Wheel, Halo Tactical Command Center V12, Market Observatory, Cargo Profit Engine, Sushir 3D Studio. Cooking: Add the Duo Display build log, making-of, installers and a visual README; Add Winding Sky real-time 3D render showcase; Add a copyable GPT code walkthrough prompt; Harden live comparison handling and add OMEN/VS Code verification; Show the source and tests in two dashboard code panels; Give the project a clearer front door; Add CodeQL and Dependabot security automation
